agent_notes: Watts from retailer/manufacturer spec lines of typical units; hours, minutes, gphPerGal, CO2 refill, EI and two-part pack life not stated by any opened page. Only pages opened with WebFetch are cited.

watts.note: 357 GPH ~ 6.5 gal/gal/h at 55 gal (zero head); 23 W is 23% below our 30 W, just outside the 20% band. Other pumps (Jebao DCP-3000 ~28-30 W) only seen in search snippets.

hours.note: Spec pages give no run hours; a return pump runs continuously by design.

gphPerGal.note: Only hobby forum threads (reefcentral, ultimatereef) found via search, saying roughly 4-6x system volume per hour for the sump return; none opened, no manufacturer page found.

hours.note: Photoperiod-linked solenoid timing is user choice; no spec page states hours.

refill.galMonthsPerRefill.note: No opened page gives a 5 lb cylinder life on a stated tank size in gallons. gensou.sg/?p=26058 says a 5 kg cylinder lasts 4-8 months on a 120 cm tank (size in gallons not given), so not usable; Fluval FAQ (403) not opened.

sources.states: 1 capful (5 mL) per 50 US gal daily or every other day
sources.quote: Thereafter use 1 capful for every 200 L (50 US gallons) daily or every other day.
Sizes: 50 mL, 100 mL, 250 mL, 500 mL, 2 L, 4 L

monthly.months.note: 20 gal: 5 mL x 20/50 = 2 mL/day = ~61 mL/month; 500 mL / 61 = 8.2 months at daily dosing (16 months if every other day). Capful = 5 mL from the same page's initial-dose line.

monthly.months.decision: Nathan 2026-10-20: derived, Seachem: 6 tabs per 10 gal every 3-4 months, so 12 a round at 20 gal; a 40-pack lasts about 12 months

sources.states: 10 gal needs 6 tabs; replace every 3-4 months
sources.quote: Add new tablets once every three to four months for optimal plant growth.

monthly.months.note: 10 gal = 6 tabs (page: 'A standard 10 gallon aquarium requires 6 tabs'), so 20 gal = 12 tabs per round; 40 tabs / 12 = 3.3 rounds x 3.5 months = ~11.7 months. A 10-pack would last ~3 months. Pack size depends on which pack is bought.
Only forum doses (e.g. ~1/4 tsp KNO3 three times a week for 20-40 gal on UKAPS) seen in search; no opened vendor page gives pack mass plus dose, so no calculation possible.
Two-part dose depends on measured demand, not a label rate per volume per week; no opened page states it.

minutes.mode.note: No manufacturer page stating minutes found. Only forums (monsterfishkeepers, ukaps) say canister mechanical media is cleaned every few weeks to 3 months or when flow drops.
